title: Clear as Mud
subtitle: podcast, host & producer
body: Founded and hosted a long-form interview podcast at mudstack — twenty-six-plus episodes across Spotify and Apple, half-hour to forty-five-minute conversations with studio directors, technical designers, and founders about the parts of the work that don’t make it into the press release. Built and ran as the company’s sole content function alongside its blog, webinars, and documentation.
